title: Speed, Density & Pressure

problems_fixed.what: Correct answer option was 6.43 cm; the true cube root of 270 is 6.46 cm (2 d.p.). The stored misconception text even computed 6.46 while listing 6.43. Fixed option[0] to '6.46 cm'.

misconceptions_enriched: All 40 misconceptions given honest expect keys (option index the named error yields, or null where the wrong answer is not a single listed option). Rewrote 10 messages to derive the specific wrong value (e.g. bronze[5] 8÷25=0.32, silver[3] 1.2×2.5=3.0, silver[5] 60÷0.75=80 km/h, gold[1] added densities 8×160=1280, gold[2] both cube-root errors).
opener_concept: A coach trip (120 miles over 3 hours = 40 mph) and a runner (100 m per 10 s = 10 m/s): a student shares distance over time by common sense, then the reveal names it as Speed = Distance ÷ Time and links the identical shape to Density and Pressure.
tier_guides: Added bronze (pick formula + one step), silver (rearrange + convert units), gold (multi-step + compound units, average-speed trap). Each with a worked example.
teach_walks: bronze train 300 km/5 h with triangle rearrangements; silver 30 km in 24 min with two-way minute/hour conversion; gold 90 km in 50 min to m/s via compound-unit conversion plus km/h cross-check. 4 numeric boxes each.
figures_note: Speed/density/pressure is a textual calculation topic; GCSE papers print these as word problems with no given figure. Exam-realism test → no figures. Opener claims no unshown figure.
style_fixes: Replaced pre-existing em dashes in worked_examples step labels ('Step 1 — Formula' → 'Step 1: Formula') to satisfy the no-em-dash rule.
preservation: method_card, topic_links, related_videos, worked_examples (bar em-dash labels), and all problem displays/solutions (bar gold[2] answer text) preserved.
notes: All 20 problems fresh-solved from display: only gold[2] was wrong. Validator PASS; PATCH 204; live round-trip confirms guided + tier_guides + fixed option + hints.
